messages:
oncall-bot: INCIDENT ALERT — elevated tail latency and error spike across EU edge fleet (eu-west-1). severity: P1. paging @ashwin.k @maria.p @elaine. auto-triage: 95th latency > 1.2s for generations, 5xx rate up x4. links: https://console.redwood.internal/incidents/1764123456 :rotating_light:

oncall-bot: Current traffic distribution: primary-provider (region-eu) 92%, alt-provider 8%. KV cache hit is normal. No config deploys in last 30m.

ashwin.k: I'm on it. looking at per-route perf now. can someone drop the quick customer impact?
maria.p: support noted spike in chat & embeddings for several customers in EU. a couple of enterprise tenants reported slow responses and timeouts (tickets #CS-2412, #CS-2417). impacting interactive apps >10s in worst cases. no data loss.

ashwin.k: ok. hypothesis: provider-side networking congestion + partial GPU saturation causing long tail. plan: immediate traffic shaping to reduce load on eu-west primary, then partial brownout of non-critical features (structured-output mode) to reduce tokens. if that fails, failover larger % to alt-provider. doing small steps.

elaine: +1. prefer gradual weight shift first. i'll prepare runbook steps. ordering: 1) apply 20% reroute to alt-provider, 2) enable 2s soft-rate-limit per org for interactive routes, 3) disable structured-output feature flag in eu-west.

ashwin.k: executing step 1 now — applying route weights (control plane).

ashwin.k: run: ```
# CLI to adjust provider weight for region
redwoodctl traffic set-weight --region eu-west-1 --provider alt-provider --weight 0.20 --reason "mitigate eu tail latency"
```

deploy-bot: deploy accepted, change id d-98321 queued to control-plane. estimated propagation ~18s. :rocket:

oncall-bot: control-plane update applied: alt-provider weight=0.20 for eu-west-1 (d-98321).

maria.p: seeing initial drop in errors on primary within 30s. 95th latency reduced ~15% so far. still some residual 5xx. Sam, can you alert top impacted customers that we're mitigating?
sam.support: sending fast note now. template used: "We're aware of elevated latency in EU regions; mitigation in progress; no data loss; updates to follow." pinging PMs and AE owning top accounts. :email:

ashwin.k: proceeding with step 2 (soft rate limit). this is per-org soft-limiter that returns 429 for interactive endpoints after threshold; set gentle limits to avoid mass failures. run: ```
redwoodctl quota update --region eu-west-1 --route /v1/generate --soft-rate 2r/s --burst 10 --reason "mitigate tail latency"
```

deploy-bot: quota update accepted (q-44211). changes will be live in ~12s.

oncall-bot: quota change live.

elaine: monitoring. looks like 95th now down ~30% vs alert baseline. 5xx reduced but not fully back to normal. decide on step 3?

ashwin.k: yes. structured-output is expensive token-wise and used by non-critical customers. toggling off in eu-west only. command: ```
redwoodctl feature-toggle set --region eu-west-1 --feature structured-output --state off --reason "reduce token pressure"
```

deploy-bot: feature toggle applied (f-1107).

maria.p: nice — CPU/GPU utilization trending down. error rate ~back to normal for most routes. a few heavy tenants still seeing degraded experience; maybe they are pinned to primary-provider.

ashwin.k: that's expected. next step: shift pinned flows if safe. I propose 40% shift for pinned routing groups for next 30m and open a temporary override for enterprise tenants to maintain data isolation if requested. any objections?

elaine: go ahead. add a TTL on the override (30m). include rollback command in runbook.

ashwin.k: applying pinned-group shift: ```
redwoodctl routing override --region eu-west-1 --group pinned --weight 0.40 --ttl 1800 --note "mitigate tail latency"
```

deploy-bot: override applied (o-77712).

oncall-bot: Monitoring events — latency stabilizing. overall 95th latency now within SLO+20%. continuing to watch for oscillation. :white_check_mark:

maria.p: summary for execs: initial mitigation sequence reduced customer impact significantly. actions taken: weight 20% to alt-provider; applied soft per-route rate limits; disabled structured-output in eu-west; applied pinned-group 40% shift with 30m TTL. no config rollbacks required.

sam.support: updated CS tickets and customers. noted temporary feature disable and soft-limits. customers asking ETA for full restoration — estimate 45-60m for full normalization and verification.

ashwin.k: forwarding to next on-call for overnight follow-up. handoff notes: 1) keep TTL overrides until verified metrics stable for 45m. 2) if error rate climbs >2x baseline revert weight to 10% and re-evaluate. 3) if 5xx persists after 60m run failover to alt-provider 60% (execute command below). 4) contact alt-provider on-call (pager id in runbook) if latency spikes there.

register-hand-off: ashwin.k -> maria.p : I'm handing off at 2024-11-09 22:58 UTC. leaving runbook steps and links. please ack.
maria.p: ack. taking over. thanks for clear notes. i'll monitor dashboards and follow escalation if needed.

elaine: please keep the feature flag off until Maria confirms. also create a post-incident checklist item: investigate why primary provider had networking congestion and whether we can pre-warm alternate paths.

ashwin.k: noted — will create follow-up ticket in infra backlog (INFRA-617).

maria.p: quick note for on-call: rollback commands if we need to return to baseline: ```
# reset provider weights
redwoodctl traffic set-weight --region eu-west-1 --provider alt-provider --weight 0.08 --reason "rollback to baseline"
# re-enable feature
redwoodctl feature-toggle set --region eu-west-1 --feature structured-output --state on --reason "rollback after mitigation"
# remove override
redwoodctl routing override delete --id o-77712 --reason "rollback"
```

oncall-bot: NOTE: If you escalate to provider failover >50% please inform SRE lead and PG before action. logging auto-collect attached: https://console.redwood.internal/logs/1764123456

sam.support: customers updated — no angry posts yet, CS prioritizing affected enterprise tenants.

maria.p: continuing to monitor. will post updates every 10m or on significance. handing off to follow-up channel after stabilization.

ashwin.k: thanks all. good collaboration. :heart:

maria.p: 10m update: metrics remain stable; 95th latency ~12% above SLO, error rate normal. leaving overrides until further notice. next update in 20m.
